sections.title: A research reading-room for the papers of Father Solanus Casey
sections.body: Ask the archive and get answers grounded in his ~570 letters and ~716 notebook pages — every claim cited to the exact scanned region. Explore the people, places, and connections as a knowledge graph; trace where he was as he wrote; and watch the retrieval pipeline light up as it works.

sections.label: his constant refrain
sections.caption: Solanus Casey (1870–1957) was the Capuchin porter at St. Bonaventure Monastery in Detroit. Petitioners wrote from everywhere; he answered, enrolled them in the Seraphic Mass Association, and recorded the favors reported back.
